3. It is not necessary for family to reside with the Government servant so as to be eligible for the concession. Full reimbursement as per entitlement shall be allowed for journeys on LTC by family members from any place in India to Headquarters and back. When journey is performed from Home town, the LTC will be counted against 'Home town LTC'; otherwise against 'All India LTC'. - GID (23), Rule 7.
